units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>; Lam. R. introd. 4 (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:23">Gen. III, 23</cite> sq.) <he>דנתי אותו בשלוחין ובג׳</he> I punished him with expulsion and banishment.—

<cite ref="Gittin 64a:2">Gitt. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>שליש אומר לגי׳</he> the trustee says (the letter has been given me not as a deposit but) as a letter of divorce which I was authorized by thy wife to receive in her behalf.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:16">Y. Kidd. I, 58ᶜ</cite> top <he>גוים אין להן ג׳</he> the law of divorce (according to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:3">Deut. XXIV, 3</cite>) does not apply to gentiles.

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:3">Ib.</cite> <he>או שאין להם ג׳ וכ׳</he> either they have not the institution of divorce, or either may divorce the other; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 18:5">Gen. R. s. 18</cite>; a. fr.
